activities.name: Colosseum
activities.description: Start the day with a visit to the iconic Colosseum. Light crowds and cool weather make mornings ideal.

activities.name: Lunch at Da Enzo al 29
activities.description: Enjoy authentic Roman cuisine with a gluten-free menu. A favorite, located in the charming Trastevere area.

activities.name: Trastevere
activities.description: Explore the quaint streets of Trastevere, known for its vibrant atmosphere and historical charm.

restStops.name: Caffè Greco
restStops.description: Historic cafe in Rome with elegant interiors.

restStops.name: Villa Borghese Gardens
restStops.description: A large, beautiful park perfect for a restful break.

options.details: Use bus 75 from Colosseum to Trastevere. Accessible with low floors.

day1.budgetEstimate: €50 per person per day, excluding meals

activities.name: Pantheon
activities.description: Visit the awe-inspiring Pantheon early to avoid crowds and enjoy the morning light.

activities.name: Lunch at Pizzarium
activities.description: Famous for its gluten-free pizza options, this place is a must-try for food enthusiasts.

activities.name: Vatican Museums
activities.description: Spend the afternoon exploring the vast collection of art and history at the Vatican Museums.

restStops.name: Giardini del Quirinale
restStops.description: A serene garden perfect for a mid-morning rest.

restStops.name: Campo de' Fiori
restStops.description: A lively market square ideal for an afternoon break.

options.details: Take Metro A from Pantheon to Vatican City. Stations have elevator access.

day2.budgetEstimate: €60 per person per day, excluding meals
